lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines are visible across the torso. Spacing is broader in the posterior region and gradually constricts as the lines progress toward the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is observed at the dorsal termination of the fourth line (counting from the posterior), where the line splits into two distinct segments near the spinal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most vertical line is fragmented into three distinct segments. The third and fifth lines exhibit terminations before reaching the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch, positioned below the primary vertical lines and above the knee joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally to form a semi-continuous geometric line segment approximately 15 degrees from the horizontal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white transverse band visible on the lower legs above the hooves and a distinct white patch on the bridge of the muzzle.
